readingUncertainties: The STBY start times are not printed. I read the single printed time as the end of the window because it sits under the 'Off Duty' column, exactly as it does for flight duties, and subtracted the 'Duty' length. The alternative reading (printed time = start) cannot be ruled out from the numbers alone, only from column alignment. Header totals cannot distinguish the two, since standby contributes no block hours.
No year is printed on any row; 2026 is taken from the stated covered period.

The Off Duty time is consistently STA + 30 min on every flight duty, implying a 30 minute post-flight debrief, but that offset is not stated in the header — I took the printed Off Duty values rather than computing them.

derivations.method: STD 19:50Z minus the 80 min long-haul offset (MAD-BOG, 10h15 block). Verified: 18:30Z to printed Off Duty 06:35Z = 12h05, the printed Duty.
STD 23:30Z minus 80 min long-haul (BOG-MAD, 10h15). Verified: 22:10Z to 10:15Z next day = 12h05.
Standby start derived as printed Off Duty 14:00Z minus printed Duty 10h00 = 04:00Z. No reporting offset applied — standby report is the start of the window.
Standby start = Off Duty 18:00Z minus Duty 6h00 = 12:00Z. No offset.
STD 08:15Z minus 80 min long-haul (MAD-BOS, 7h30). Verified: 06:55Z to 16:15Z = 9h20.
STD 03:10Z minus 80 min long-haul (BOS-MAD, 7h30). Verified: 01:50Z to 11:10Z = 9h20.
Standby start = Off Duty 19:00Z minus Duty 7h00 = 12:00Z. No offset.
Standby start = Off Duty 19:00Z minus Duty 8h00 = 11:00Z. No offset.
First sector STD 03:55Z minus the 50 min short-haul offset (four European sectors). Verified: 03:05Z to 14:29Z = 11h24.

STD 14:30Z minus 80 min long-haul (DXB-MAD, 7h00). Verified: 13:10Z to 22:00Z = 8h50.
Standby start = Off Duty 19:00Z minus Duty 7h00 = 12:00Z. No offset.
First (morning) duty: STD 05:50Z minus 50 min short-haul (MAD-DUB). Verified: 05:00Z to 12:34Z = 7h34.
Second (night) duty on the same date: STD 23:25Z minus 50 min short-haul (MAD-FCO). Verified: 22:35Z on 19SEP to 12:45Z on 20SEP = 14h10, which only works if the duty is treated as spanning midnight.
